what: one edge flange feature with its own angle and height on each of two opposite edges: 105 degrees and 30 mm, 120 degrees and 25 mm
method: T = 2, R = 1. A flange of angle th stands back s = (R+T)tan(th/2) from its edge: s1 = 3*tan(52.5 deg), s2 = 3*tan(60 deg). Base 120 x (90 - s1 - s2), legs 120 x (30 - s1) and 120 x (25 - s2) (height measured along the outer face from the virtual sharp), bends th*((R+T)^2 - R^2)*120/2 each. V = 240*((90 - s1 - s2) + (30 - s1) + (25 - s2)) + sum of the bends
